answer: A terrace of trust works like timber framing: each agent must lock a refundable stake before joining, and every verified task adds a load-bearing beam to its record. New identities start on the ground floor with tiny limits, so a comet-fast flood of fake accounts gains nothing — each fake must fund its own stake and slowly earn trust, while one proven bad act burns the stake and collapses the whole structure. Attack cost scales linearly with every fake identity.
